claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the product for leaving skin soft, hydrated, and moisturized, often noticing results by morning.
Many reviewers highlight the generous amount of product per packet, noting it covers the face plus neck/chest and can often be stretched to two uses.
The light, fresh, pleasant scent and non-greasy gel consistency that absorbs well are commonly mentioned positives.
Several reviewers value the individually wrapped packets as convenient for travel and a good value for the price.
A few reviewers note the lack of English instructions/ingredients on the packaging, and one reports seeing no results at all.
